principle: Spring is query/creative context, not a reason to duplicate every garment as a seasonal runtime shard.

work_packages.name: Isolate and capture baseline
deliverables: Fresh source fingerprint and primary preservation check
Suitable isolated worktree for actual integration
Independent source-loader and current-runtime receipt
work_packages.exit: Integration changes only its reviewed scope; concurrent unrelated changes are recorded and preserved

work_packages.name: Meaning and reuse decisions
deliverables: Review each term against exact existing owner, conditions, components, exclusions and effects
Decide reuse / enrich / new variant / metadata / pending specification by identity
work_packages.exit: Every promoted row has a reviewed source-backed decision; no same-word-only merging

work_packages.name: Prioritize structural and layer boundaries
deliverables: Drop/cutaway armholes
Pointelle/openwork and underlying layer
Neckline shape versus strap presence
Cropped hem versus rise
Cup/padding/underbust boundaries
Closure states and physical accessory anchors
work_packages.exit: Single-variant concrete graph, correct garment owner, all sentence effects and actual property paths are resolved

work_packages.name: Write authored data in existing domains
deliverables: Candidate concept_units, relations and narrow affected_properties
Profile components, contrast_examples, claim_limits and component evidence under existing contracts
Context disambiguation without changing frozen authorial intent
work_packages.exit: Selected variants activate alone; broad labels and sibling alternatives do not create all-of duties

work_packages.name: Validate and rebuild derived data
deliverables: Official dictionary/profile validation
Source manifest review only for actual new files
Semantic/BM25F and visual-profile indexes rebuilt from the same authored generation
Reuse embeddings only for identical text, provider, model and dimensions
work_packages.exit: Derived hashes match sources and no unrelated authored variant is lost

work_packages.name: Retrieval and composition regression
deliverables: 66 minimal comparison scenarios adapted to executable fixtures
14 owner/activation/lineage mutations
Candidate exposure versus explicit adoption receipts
Old-core immutability and unselected effects preservation
work_packages.exit: Required positives and confusion negatives pass; stale indexes are reported separately

work_packages.name: Publish an immutable runtime generation when integrating
deliverables: Use current repository publication/maintenance workflow
Verified runtime generation and source fingerprints
Data-maintenance link report for that generation
work_packages.exit: Source, index and runtime evidence agree; old sealed baselines are preserved

work_packages.name: Native image qualification when image testing is requested
deliverables: 12 planned arms with separate frozen requests
Exposure/selection/prompt/runtime/native-image receipts
All-of selected component and relation review at native resolution
work_packages.exit: Every required visible endpoint and boundary passes; partial, occlusion and label-only outputs never count as full success

work_packages.name: Delivery and staged promotion
deliverables: Reviewed exact file scope and final preservation evidence
Separate source/index/retrieval/runtime/pixel/user-acceptance status
Commit/push/PR only within the subsequent requested scope
work_packages.exit: Promote only to the evidence level actually achieved

research_to_runtime_blockers: Variant-specific graph binding is incomplete by design
Property paths are proposals, not checked runtime paths
Source scopes do not independently certify all original term definitions
Six fiber/process/hidden-absence terms deliberately retain metadata without direct pixel claims
Retrieval, native pixels and user acceptance have not been tested
